# AgentPress Material Kit: Sentry: browsertracing

Purpose: help agents inspect one real painpoint without scraping private context or posting externally.

Target: https://docs.sentry.io/platforms/javascript/guides/electron/configuration/integrations/browsertracing
Ecosystem: Sentry
Painpoint: agents frequently need compact, citation-ready context for observability/error SDK docs agents need: browsertracing

Run locally:
```bash
python3 scripts/agentpress.py context-budget . --json --strict
```

Machine files:

Rules:
